name: kosa8 Cloud
from: No free tier, credit, trial or pay as you go. Every account adds a card and picks a plan, from $29 a month, charged at checkout, before it uses kosa8 on any platform, including your own computer. Accounts made before 16 November 2026 keep working until 1 December 2026, then need a plan.
to: Starter: $10 of kosa8 Cloud usage once, with no card and no time limit, after you confirm your email. It runs 2 sandboxes at once, each up to 2 vCPU / 4 GB, in sessions of up to 60 minutes, with outbound network limited to an allow-list; work stops at the limit and Starter never sends a bill. Anyone can also try 15 minutes of run time per 24 hours on kosa8's website without an account.

name: Box by Simular
from: 5,000 box credits once ($5), valid 90 days: about 50 hours of box time at 100 credits an hour.
to: 5,000 box credits once ($5), valid 90 days: about 25 hours of box time on the Free box (4 vCPU / 8 GB) at 200 credits an hour.

name: Replit
from: Starter plan: free daily credits for Replit AI up to a monthly cap and monthly credits for cloud usage, with one published app.
to: A 3-day free trial of Core after sign-up, for eligible new users; who is eligible and whether a card is needed are not stated. The free Starter plan no longer takes new users; those already on it keep a limited free allowance for Replit AI, monthly cloud credits and one published app.
